objective: Choose a switching plan that isolates a faulted distribution feeder section, keeps the energized network radial, and restores high-priority load through available tie switches.

submission_schema.open_switches: List of branch/switch IDs to open before restoration.
submission_schema.close_switches: List of normally-open tie switch IDs to close for restoration.

hard_constraints: All faulted branches must be open in the final switching state.
The energized graph must remain radial; meshed final states are rejected.
Restored load is counted only for load buses reachable from the source bus.
Priority-restored score must meet min_priority_restored for this public case.

metrics.name: feasible
metrics.description: Whether fault isolation, radiality, and required priority restoration are all satisfied.

metrics.name: priority_restored
metrics.description: Sum of priority weights for restored load buses.

metrics.name: restored_load_kw
metrics.description: Total restored load reachable from the source bus.

metrics.name: switch_count
metrics.description: Number of open and close switching actions.

metrics.name: score
metrics.description: Normalized [0,1] priority restoration score minus a scaled switch-count penalty if feasible, else 0.

source_provenance.title: A Two-Stage Service Restoration Method for Electric Power Distribution Systems
source_provenance.notes: Primary source for distribution service-restoration / feeder reconfiguration task structure with switching actions and restored-load objective.
